summary.intent: Apply the owner's final change to PR #638: remove prompt signal handling from callisto-cli's tty.rs (keeping only the SIGINT-ignore rule while $EDITOR runs), update the pty test, spec and changeset, run the full gate, and commit locally without pushing.
summary.outcome: Signal thread, STATE mutex, Mode::RestoreTerminal and react() were removed, the editor flag rule kept, crossterm dropped as a direct dep, and the pty test, cli.json and changeset updated. The work went beyond the stated scope (E343 rendering on cancel, new pty tests); all four gates exited 0 and a signed commit was made locally, but the sha and diff stat were not reported in the transcript and nothing was pushed.

repo: Prompt cancel maps to CliError::Cancelled and exit 130 via tty::CANCELLED_BY_CTRL_C; inquire reads Ctrl-C and Esc as keys so no custom signal handling is needed at prompts.
docs/specs/cli.json holds criteria (e.g. CLI-ADD-03/04/05, CLI-INIT-10) that tests and docs checks read, so spec wording changes affect doc-check.
Without git the workspace is rejected earlier with E058, so the 'could not tell which packages changed' warning cannot be triggered through the real binary and is covered only by a unit test.
Cargo.lock changes when a direct dependency such as crossterm is dropped; this is expected and should be committed.
signal-hook's flag::register_conditional_default lets SIGINT be ignored while a flag is false and restored to default on Drop, with no thread.

code.finding: Reduced to a thin prompt wrapper plus an editor_owns_ctrl_c module (unix: signal_hook flag guard; non-unix: no-op guard).
Cancelled is now rendered through the normal error path with exit code forced to 130 rather than a special-case print arm.

workflow: Run gates sequentially and judge each by exit code, redirecting output to log files; the first pre-push failure was formatting only, fixed with cargo fmt.
A change made mid-gate (the Cancelled rendering) invalidates a running gate, so the gate was stopped and restarted.
TMPDIR-based log paths failed in one step, so logs were moved to the job tmp dir.
